name: CultureChip
role: The CULTURE: EGYPT ▾ chip in the SubBar and instrument bar; opens a five-item menu that rewrites ?culture= in the URL and persists the choice.

name: FeedbackRow
role: The on-device verdict line under a reading: AGAINST THIS READING → IT WAS SO · IT WAS NOT SO · KEPT ON THIS DEVICE.
sampleProps: { readingId: "rome:2026-09-06:mars-scorpio-10", noun: "READING" }

name: HorizonControl
role: The D · W · S · Y segmented control that moves the reader between the day, week, season and year horizons.
sampleProps: { active: "week" }

name: Lintel
role: The nave header: TODAY · VOICES · LEARN on the left, ASTRA ANTIQVA centered, CHARTS · ACCOUNT on the right; collapses to an INDEX disclosure below 720px.
sampleProps: { active: "today" }

name: MethodFooter
role: The honesty footer every reading chassis ends with: ASTRONOMY-ENGINE EPHEMERIS · WHOLE-SIGN · ORBS DOCUMENTED → METHOD, and NO ACCOUNT NEEDED · AN ACCOUNT ADDS SYNC.

name: NaveHead
role: Centered page head: mono kicker, 64x1 accent rule, Cinzel headline, optional sub block, closing rule.
sampleProps: { kicker: "THE SIBYLLINE BOOKS · 6 SEPTEMBER 2026", children: "MARS ENTERS SCORPIO", sub: MARS 0°00' SCORPIO → 14°22' · THE TENTH HOUSE }

name: OrbBar
role: 3px orb-tightness track under an aspect row: the fill shrinks as the orb widens toward the maximum.
sampleProps: { orb: 1.4, maxOrb: 8, tone: "conflict" }

name: ReceptionNote
role: The honesty note on outer-planet surfaces: names the modern body, says it was received into the ancient manner, and points at METHOD.
sampleProps: { intro: "PLOUTON IS A MODERN BODY, RECEIVED INTO THE GREEK MANNER." }

name: SectionDivider
role: Centered Cinzel caption flanked by 1px rules; breaks a reading's spine into sections.
sampleProps: { label: "THE PLANETS IN THEIR HOUSES" }

name: Skeleton
role: Loading state for a reading: three faint rules and a dim mono label. Never spins.
sampleProps: { label: "COMPUTING THE SKY…" }

name: SpanBar
role: 12-month span track: a positioned fill between two percents with bone tick marks for exact passes (a transit's span across the year).
sampleProps: { startPct: 18, endPct: 61, ticks: [27, 44, 58], tone: "conflict" }

name: SubBar
role: 46px context row under the Lintel: truncating context line, optional D·W·S·Y control, culture chip, and SYNC flag.
sampleProps: { context: "6 SEPTEMBER 2026 · SUN 13°48' VIRGO · MOON 2°10' CAPRICORN", horizon: "day", showSync: true }

name: SyncFlag
role: The SYNC ON / SYNC OFF indicator in the SubBar, a tiny client island over the auth state.

name: Votive
role: The votive instruction: a two-line imperative in accent Cinzel, bordered top and bottom, closing a reading.
sampleProps: { children: "POUR THE LIBATION BEFORE THE FIRST HOUR.\nSPEAK THE NAME OF MARS AND GO OUT." }

name: WheelSvg
role: Server-safe pure SVG natal wheel: three rings, twelve spokes, sign abbreviations, planet glyphs (nudged inward on collision), aspect lines and an accent ascendant line.
sampleProps: { chart: { sun: 25.5, moon: 98.2, mercury: 12.8, venus: 52.1, mars: 224.37, jupiter: 160.3, saturn: 305.7, uranus: 288.4, neptune: 283.1, pluto: 232.9 }, ascendant: 128.0, aspects: [{ planetA: "mars", planetB: "saturn", kind: "square" }, { planetA: "moon", planetB: "neptune", kind: "opposition" }, { planetA: "sun", planetB: "jupiter", kind: "trine" }, { planetA: "venus", planetB: "moon", kind: "sextile" }], accentPlanets: ["mars"], size: 400, caption: "NATAL · MARS 14°22' SCORPIO · THE TENTH HOUSE" }
